bio.text: Edwin Rivera is the Republican candidate for Virginia's 3rd Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election.
According to Ballotpedia, he grew up in Puerto Rico, lives in Newport News, Virginia, and served in the U.S. Army.
The Virginia Mercury describes him as an Army veteran who served several combat tours in the Middle East, and as a father of seven; Ballotpedia lists police officer in his career experience.
